notes: Trigger queries: run each 3 times in a project with the skill installed (claude -p --output-format json) and count Skill tool calls. should_trigger passes above 0.5, should_not_trigger below it. Tasks: run in a copy of the setup, then node scripts/check.mjs must exit 0 (values kept on purpose carry a toko-keep comment) and the listed expectations must hold. Sync tasks need the Toko CLI, and for the MCP variant the Toko MCP server too; without the server the agent should use toko set or toko push.

update my Toko palette, I just replaced the files

Card has data-surface=raised, DropdownMenuContent has data-surface=overlay
no palette classes remain; the button uses bg-action-primary

the build passes
